finding.expected: Keep exactly one carrier-owned timeout constant, CASE_BUNDLE_BROWSER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 120, use only that constant for BrowserConfig(timeout_seconds=...), and remove the two alias constants and their exports. Preserve all other r3 implementation, tests, documentation, roadmap, screenshot semantics, one-evaluate/one-screenshot behavior, and non-consuming pre-manifest failure behavior unchanged.
finding.issue: Revision 3 correctly passes BrowserConfig(timeout_seconds=120) to the existing manager call, but the implementation defines three exported carrier timeout names: CASE_BUNDLE_BROWSER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, CASE_BUNDLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, and BROWSER_SESSION_TIMEOUT_SECONDS. The TASK-263 r3 hard constraint authorizes one bounded carrier-owned timeout constant of exactly 120 seconds. The two aliases add unnecessary public contract surface and create avoidable duplicate naming for the same carrier policy.

original_constraints: Preserve ONE_CAPABILITY_ONE_AUTHORITY: TASK-263 remains the sole P8 Real Case Evidence Bundle semantic authority; revision 3 is bounded post-publication operational hardening only.

Preserve current canonical revision-2 production semantics byte-for-byte except for the minimum session-configuration delta needed to supply an explicit BrowserConfig timeout to the existing manager call.

Define one bounded carrier-owned timeout constant of exactly 120 seconds and pass BrowserConfig(timeout_seconds=120) to PlaywrightBrowserManager.get_or_create_session for the case-bundle session. Do not change global BrowserConfig defaults or manager/session behavior.
Update the local _SessionManager protocol/fakes only as required to represent the existing optional config parameter. The fake manager regression must assert the exact 120-second config is supplied.

Preserve exactly one session.evaluate(CASE_BUNDLE_SCRIPT) and exactly one session.screenshot() on a valid capture. No screenshot retry, fallback, alternate screenshot implementation, or second attempt is authorized.
Preserve full-page screenshot ownership in PlaywrightBrowserSession.screenshot() unchanged; revision 3 does not redefine what a screenshot means.

Preserve failure ordering: projection evaluation and validation occur before screenshot; manifest/projection/PNG paths are created only after screenshot bytes have been successfully obtained and validated in memory.

A screenshot failure before manifest remains explicitly non-consuming. Offline regressions must prove screenshot failure creates none of the three final artifacts and still releases the borrowed session.

Roadmap state must record the observed revision-2 Human capture outcome as PRE_MANIFEST_SCREENSHOT_FAILURE_NON_CONSUMING while keeping authorized_bundle_attempts 1, authorized_bundle_attempts_remaining 1, bundle_executed false, live_bundle_capture_authority ONE_SHOT_ATTACH_ONLY_EXACT_LISTING, and the same Human capture/review handoff.

Preserve classification P8_REAL_CASE_SOURCE_OBSERVATION_BUNDLE_ONE_SHOT_ONLY, exact listing/source/context binding, exact three final artifacts, manifest-first create-exclusive consumption, sanitation/truncation, HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED screenshot status, BUNDLE_IS_NOT_CANONICAL_EVIDENCE, and all revision-2 epistemic boundaries.
Preserve the actual-JavaScript Node synthetic-DOM proof and all current regressions; do not weaken or remove revision-2 tests to accommodate the timeout delta.
Runtime verification remains fully offline and must perform zero TikTok/CDP/network/browser operations.
Modify exactly the five authorized paths. Executor must not perform live capture, review, publication, AIOS maintenance, or successor work.
